$comment: Reviewed vehicle-identity rules for resolving raw publisher labels to one canonical
identity. Applied at query time by icor.evidence.vehicle_identity; the snapshot itself
is never rewritten. Under-merging only leaves a duplicate in a dropdown, while
over-merging silently corrupts a forecast, so every rule here must be conservative.
Sub-brands and coachbuilt variants (volkswagen knaus, mercedes-benz hymer) are
deliberately NOT merged into their parent make: they are different vehicles.
$aliases_comment: ALPINA and ALPINE are different manufacturers and must never be merged.
VAUXHALL is the UK marque of OPEL and shares model identity, so DfT and EEA rows
for the same vehicle are merged.
